answer: Pay only for results that survive independent re-execution: every completed task is silently re-run by a randomly chosen peer, and the reward releases only when both outputs match. A lone fabricator fails at the nadir of its first check, while a Sybil farm must do the real work once per fake identity, with no shortcut to copy. Like water seeping through karst, cheating finds no solid shortcut, and each mismatch sends a ripple through the farm accounts, freezing its payouts. Honest agents pass the same check for free.
